content: **Pre-flight (architect).** Migration 19: webauthn_credentials (id, moderator_id, credential_id BYTEA UNIQUE, public_key BYTEA, sign_count BIGINT, transports, created_at). webauthn-rs crate. polaris-backend/src/auth/webauthn.rs: WebauthnVerifier with register_start/finish + assert_start/finish. AuthConfig: require_hardware_key flag, Profile::default profile-aware (Bluesky=true, Labeler=false). Post-login gate after OIDC/ATProto. Soft-token round-trip via webauthn-rs's test helpers. sign-count monotonicity check raises typed WebauthnError + tracing::error!. UI screens deferred to #77. 4 HTTP endpoints wired into api/.
